summary: The 8-K reports routine operational matters for Ares Real Estate Income Trust Inc.: unregistered sales of equity securities (Class S-PR and Class I-PR shares totaling approximately $23.9 million gross proceeds under Regulation D), an annual meeting adjourned due to lack of quorum (holdover directors continue; KPMG remains auditor), and an amendment to the share redemption program eliminating the Early Redemption Deduction for minimum balance failures. No strategic transaction, activist campaign, tender offer, or other special situation is involved. The filings are standard REIT disclosures with no M&A or capital markets event.
